hypothesis.causal_question: Does deterministic relative-time annotation improve the complete Entity-Memory graph method under the frozen LoCoMo Reader and evaluator?
hypothesis.control: Validated complete B at top_k=25 with time annotations enabled.
hypothesis.matched_dense_control: Validated A_raw_text at top_k=25 with time annotations disabled.
hypothesis.treatment: B_raw_text changes only use_time_annotations from true to false relative to B, rebuilding the dependent Entity-Memory graph while reusing the exact A_raw_text Memory indexes.
hypothesis.expected_direction: Removing time annotations is expected to weakly reduce temporal evidence recall. Preserve a null, mixed, or unfavorable result; run input-family inference only after B_raw_text completes.

dataset.order: All 10 conversations and all 1,986 QA rows in immutable dataset order; 446 Category-5 rows; no category filter.

preprocessing.dialog_text: Raw utterance text without deterministic relative-time annotations.

extraction.effective_use: conversation-only Entity extraction for the B_raw_text graph; unchanged raw-text/cache keys may reuse exact prior extraction entries

embedding.role: context for exact A_raw_text/B_raw_text shared Memory indexes and immutable context-role question vectors

judge.reason: Formal LoCoMo uses frozen official F1 and recall_acc, not an LLM-as-Judge.

prompts.entity_extraction_unit: one normalized conversation Memory text at a time, including official caption when present
prompts.entity_schema: schema-constrained Entity keys normalized, merged, deduplicated, filtered, then linked to conversation Memories
prompts.answer_prompt: Frozen vendored LoCoMo QA prompt through the existing QARecall boundary.

training.reason: The active LoCoMo stack is inference-only.

retrieval.query: The complete current QA question, with cached question-Entity extraction physically separate from graph construction.
retrieval.tie_breaking: Committed stable gated, fused, sequence-expanded, dense-fill ordering.
retrieval.fallback: Dense semantic fill returns the exact available top-k budget even when signed similarities are negative.

generation.retry_behavior: Frozen common client behavior at committed source.

evaluation.per_row_serialization: Official three-decimal F1 and recall_acc fields.
evaluation.aggregation: Frozen official category-aware aggregation over 1,986 QA rows.
planned_comparisons: B_raw_text minus validated complete B for the within-method time-annotation ablation.
B_raw_text minus validated A_raw_text to test whether the B-over-A retrieval gain survives matched raw text.
Raw-text input-family paired-QA and conversation-cluster inference with 10,000 resamples and seed 20260727, generated only after this condition validates.

sampling_seed.reason: No sampling; immutable all-10 order is used.

randomness.retrieval: Deterministic for fixed graphs, vectors, caches, and source.
randomness.answer_generation: temperature=0, but provider/backend nondeterminism remains possible.
randomness.category5: Frozen upstream option order uses unseeded random.random(); no local seed override is permitted.

caches.query_coverage: 1,986 ordered QA rows / 1,974 unique questions; read-only; zero misses and zero live requests required.
caches.graph_identity: Entity-Memory, caption enabled, time annotations disabled, speaker Entity enabled, conversation hash, extractor model/version, graph schema.
caches.memory_index_identity: Exactly the A_raw_text raw Memory search text, caption enabled, text-embedding-3-small, conversation hash, index schema.
caches.memory_index_reuse: Require all 10 validated A_raw_text index identities to be reused read-only; graph count is expected to increase from 50 to 60 and index count to remain 30.
caches.conversation_entity_cache: May reuse only exact full-text/model/protocol keys; 352 of 5,882 Memory texts differ from the time-annotated profile and may require new extraction.
caches.question_entity_cache: Physically separate QA-derived cache keyed by sample, QA index, complete question digest, extraction model, and protocol namespace; retrieval-time only.
caches.invalidation: Disabling time annotations invalidates B graph identity, contexts, answers, and treatment metrics. It does not invalidate complete B, A_raw_text, the shared Memory indexes, or the frozen question artifact.
caches.deletion_policy: Delete no existing graph, index, extraction, question, result, or query artifact. Fail closed on an identity mismatch.

graph_build.rationale: Only 352 Memory texts differ; exact unchanged cache keys should reuse prior extraction and all Memory indexes must reuse A_raw_text.

monetary_limit.reason: Current provider pricing is not recorded; request/token ceilings are binding.

validity: Clean committed worktree and frozen evaluator.
Exact dataset and query-artifact SHA-256 match.
Condition directory is absent at start and used by one resolved condition.
B_raw_text graph build uses conversation fields only and completes all 10 graphs.
The 10 A_raw_text Memory indexes reload under exact B_raw_text identity; no new Memory embedding request is allowed.
Old graph/index/cache artifacts remain present; expected counts are graph 60 and index 30 after construction.
Both project and generic preflight gates pass.
In-run and independent validators pass 10 conversations, 1,986 QA, and 446 Category-5 rows.
Exactly 25 unique valid context ids per QA where available.
Query cache records zero misses and zero live query-embedding requests.
Mandatory conversation-only graph and graph-recall audits pass.
Frozen parameter snapshot SHA matches runtime handoff.
gates.performance: No early performance stop; preserve unfavorable, null, or mixed results and complete the predeclared raw-text family analysis.
stop_conditions: Any hidden resume, output reuse, cache conflict, query miss, or live query embedding request.
Any Memory index build request instead of exact A_raw_text index reuse.
Any forbidden graph-construction input or frozen evaluator drift.
Ten consecutive external-model connection failures; freeze evidence before a new run id.
gates.snapshot: Freeze completed, partial, failed, or aborted evidence in v50_b_raw_text_all10 before any affected source change.
gates.close: Update README, conclusion, next_steps, PLAN, and TODO; commit and push scoped evidence before B_no_speaker.

unknowns: Actual provider-resolved version identifiers for gpt-3.5-turbo and text-embedding-3-small are not exposed.
Exact monetary price and host hardware identity are unavailable.
Exact new extraction request count is unknown until build; the frozen ceiling is 400.
